movelist.name: Water Pulse
movelist.effect: Water Pulse Confuses the target on 17+.

movelist.name: Whirlpool
movelist.effect: The target is put in a Vortex.

movelist.name: Splash
movelist.effect: Shift Action - The user may make a single Jump, adding +1 to their Long Jump and High Jump values, and gains +2 Evasion until the end of their next turn.

movelist.name: Rollout
movelist.effect: The user continues to use Rollout on each of its turns until they miss any target with Rollout, or are not able to hit any target with Rollout during their turn.  Each successive use of Rollout increases Rollout’s Damage Base by +4 to a maximum of DB 15.

movelist.name: Astonish
movelist.effect: Astonish Flinches the target on 15+. Once per scene, if the target is unaware of the user’s presence, Astonish automatically Flinches the target.

abilities.name: Water Veil
abilities.effect: The user is immune to Burns. Defensive.

abilities.name: Hydration
abilities.effect: The user is cured of one Status Affliction. Hydration’s Frequency is ignored if used during Rainy Weather.
